entities.name: Go-Shintai of Hidden Cruelty
entities.description: A legendary shrine housing a Kami of Hidden Cruelty that offers vengeance.

entities.name: Kami of Hidden Cruelty
entities.description: Kami inadvertently summoned by a homeless ogre who whispered vengeful thoughts to her.

entities.name: Young ogre
entities.description: Ogre evicted from her cave who summoned the kami and murdered the warlord.

entities.name: Violent warlord
entities.description: Warlord who evicted the ogre and was murdered by her.

events.summary: A violent warlord evicts a young ogre from her cave.
events.quote: a young ogre was evicted from her cave by a violent warlord.

events.summary: Her struggle inadvertently summons a Kami of Hidden Cruelty.
events.quote: Her struggle inadvertently summoned a Kami of Hidden Cruelty.

events.summary: Urged by the kami's whispers, the ogre murders the warlord and flees.
events.quote: until she took up arms and murdered the warlord.

relations.note: Murdered him after the kami's whispers.
relations.quote: until she took up arms and murdered the warlord.
